title: Junta node sample count
statement: Let $n,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $P\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be a set of coordinates, and let $\delta\in(0,1/2]$ be a failure parameter. The junta node random-example count is the junta restriction sample count at degree parameter $k$, with the restricted sample count for $P,k,\delta$ and half the failure parameter as inputs.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$
caveat: The definitions of the junta restriction sample-count constructions are not supplied, so the numerical quantity cannot be expanded further.
